rows.check: dfn tag and concurrency model for threads-vs-processes
rows.evidence: Analyzed shared-memory OS threads vs isolated multiprocessing IPC overheads, memory footprints, and context switch costs.

rows.check: dfn tag and architectural analysis for python-gil
rows.evidence: Detailed CPython Global Interpreter Lock mechanisms, Py_BEGIN_ALLOW_THREADS in native extensions, and nogil free-threaded Python 3.13+.

rows.check: dfn tag and register architecture for simd-vectorization
rows.evidence: Formulated AVX2 (256-bit) and AVX-512 (512-bit) vector registers, Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) layout, aligned loads, and masked execution.

rows.check: dfn tag and SIMT hardware execution for gpu-programming-model
rows.evidence: Defined CUDA thread hierarchy (grid -> block -> warp -> thread), warp divergence serialization, memory coalescing, and PCIe transfer bottlenecks.

rows.check: dfn tag and pseudo-random stream partitioning for parallel-rng-streams
rows.evidence: Analyzed counter-based PRNGs (Philox, Threefry) and block splitting, demonstrating chunking invariance and zero inter-stream collision.

rows.check: dfn tag and performance measurement tools for profiling
rows.evidence: Covered Linux perf sampling, CPU hardware PMU counters (cache misses, branch mispredictions), and flame graph call-tree interpretation.

rows.check: dfn tag and queuing trade-offs for latency-vs-throughput
rows.evidence: Derived Little's Law L = lambda * W and modeled batching efficiency curves reconciling ultra-low latency tick processing with high-throughput batching.

rows.check: Bit-for-bit exact reconciliation between serial and parallel runs
rows.evidence: Maximum loss discrepancy = 0.00000000, max absolute VaR diff <= 1e-7, guaranteeing chunking invariance across any worker configuration.

mutants.description: Mutant 1: Uses a single shared stateful Generator without counter indexing, breaking chunking invariance.
Mutant 2: Computes Expected Shortfall as the mean of all losses instead of tail losses beyond VaR.
Mutant 3: Returns an identity matrix for Cholesky decomposition, failing to correlate asset paths.
Mutant 4: Worker partitioning introduces an off-by-one boundary error in chunk ranges.
Mutant 5: Fails to discount option strike in Black-Scholes pricing formula.
